description.en: Arborea arborea: whole fossil-specimen shallow relief, not living organism. Complete disc, plain stalk, broad paddle blade and paired oblique ridges informed by Dunn Liu Gehling 2019 Fig1A SAM P19690a and Fig6. Nominal 0.6m, long stalk, relief thickness, ridge count and sandstone colors are artistic, not exact specimen measurements or original biological color. Neutral plain support backside not inferred biology. No roots, modern leaf veins, Charnia fractal branching or Rangea radial vanes.
description.zh: Arborea化石标本浅浮雕，并非活体植物；尺寸、颜色与浮雕细节含艺术解释。
